bead.title: Pin fjord and bootstrap the embedded surface
bead.description:
PROBLEM: TD-008 and ADR-014 require fjord embedded in `pqueue-server`, but the server crate still only wires RESP plus object-log / SQLite / PostgreSQL backends.
ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-server/Cargo.toml:19` has no fjord dependency, and `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:867` through `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:1103` only constructs the existing backends and the Niflheim change-record emitter.
PROPOSED FIX: add a git-pinned fjord dependency per ADR-011's no-path-deps rule, extend typed config/startup so `pqueue-service` can boot the embedded fjord surface behind the delivery seam, and keep the seam swappable without changing queue correctness.
NON-SCOPE: Kafka record ordering, offsets, ACL enforcement, and external broker fallback behavior.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestFjordDependencyIsGitPinnedNoPathDeps` proves fjord is added as a git-pinned dependency and no path dependency is introduced.
2. `TestFjordBootstrapConfigWiresEmbeddedSurface` proves `pqueue-server` can boot the embedded fjord surface from typed config.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestFjordDependencyIsGitPinnedNoPathDeps|TestFjordBootstrapConfigWiresEmbeddedSurface'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
